# Marathon Training Log

Sixteen week plan for the spring marathon. Long run on Sunday, adding two kilometres a week up to thirty-two. Tuesday is intervals on the track, Thursday an easy tempo run. Knee felt tight after week six, so I swapped one run for the bike. Race pace is five minutes forty per kilometre.
The long run each week is the backbone, and I build kilometres on hills and trails when the legs allow, with easy running to recover.
